subject.title: fix(ci): accept valid Kova PASS records without violations

question: Should OpenClaw accept omitted `violations` as the no-violations encoding for Kova PASS records in the release performance gate?
rationale: The code is narrow and matches pinned Kova source, but it changes the trusted release-gate adapter that can convert a nonzero Kova verdict into effective success.

options.title: Accept After Current-Base Proof
options.body: Recommended: keep this helper shape and merge after the branch is ready and current-base proof rechecks the positive candidate plus malformed, hidden-violation, and failed-record negative cases.

options.title: Require Explicit Empty Arrays
options.body: Ask Kova or the report producer to always emit `violations: []` for PASS records and keep the OpenClaw adapter strict, at the cost of rejecting the current pinned report shape until Kova changes.

options.title: Pause Gate Relaxation
options.body: Pause or close if maintainers do not want OpenClaw's release gate adapter to own this Kova report-schema compatibility rule.

recommendation.title: Accept After Current-Base Proof
recommendation.body: Recommended: keep this helper shape and merge after the branch is ready and current-base proof rechecks the positive candidate plus malformed, hidden-violation, and failed-record negative cases.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` has the strongest current history on both the OpenClaw helper and the pinned Kova evaluator behavior this decision depends on.
